help.home.title: Your home feed
help.home.p1: See thank-yous, badges and news from across the company.
help.home.p2: Tap “Recognize someone” to thank a teammate. It takes about 30 seconds.
help.home.p3: Tap 👏 to applaud a post, or the speech bubble to comment.
help.home.p4: Add up to 4 photos to a thank-you. Tap any photo to see it full screen.
help.home.p5: Your level card shows your points and how many you can still give this month.
help.people.title: Finding people
help.people.p1: Search by name or job title, or tap a department.
help.people.p2: Open someone’s profile to see their badges and thank them.
help.badges.title: How badges work
help.badges.p1: Badges celebrate specific kinds of great work.
help.badges.p2: Tap a badge to see how to earn it and who already has it.
help.badges.p3: Managers award badges, and some can be added to a thank-you.
help.badges.p4: Every badge adds points to your total.
help.rewards.title: Spending your points
help.rewards.p1: Points you receive can be spent here.
help.rewards.p2: When you redeem, the points are held until HR approves. You can cancel any time before that.
help.rewards.p3: If HR declines, the points come straight back.
help.rewards.p4: Spending points never lowers your level.
help.wall.title: Memory Wall
help.wall.p1: A polaroid for every moment of your year, one string per month.
help.wall.p2: Thank-yous, badges, level-ups, birthdays, work anniversaries and rewards are pinned automatically.
help.wall.p3: Use Pin a Moment to add a skill you learned, a certification or an achievement — with a photo if you like.
help.wall.p4: Managers can pin moments for their team; HR and the Super Admin for anyone.
help.wall.p5: Everyone shows the company’s highlights. Switch the year to look back.
help.wall.p6: On this day: on dates with memories from earlier years you get a reminder, and Home shows them — share one again with a tap.
help.leaderboard.title: The leaderboard
help.leaderboard.p1: Shows who received the most points in the period you pick.
help.leaderboard.p2: Use the department chips to see your own team’s board.
help.notifications.title: Notifications
help.notifications.p1: You’re told when someone thanks you, comments, awards a badge or decides on a reward.
help.notifications.p2: Tap one to go straight to it.
help.team.title: Looking after your team
help.team.p1: See who has given and received recognition in the last 30 days.
help.team.p2: “Quiet” means they haven’t thanked anyone yet this month.
help.team.p3: Nudge sends them a friendly reminder (once a week at most).
help.team.p4: Recognize or award a badge right from each row.
help.admin-overview.title: Reading the overview
help.admin-overview.p1: Participation is the share of people who gave or received recognition in 30 days.
help.admin-overview.p2: “Not yet involved” lists people worth a personal nudge.
help.admin-users.title: Managing people
help.admin-users.p1: Tap Edit to change any detail: name, email, job title, employee ID, phone, birthday, joining date, team and role.
help.admin-users.p2: Birthdays and joining dates drive the automatic birthday and anniversary points.
help.admin-users.p3: Switch someone off to stop them signing in. Their history stays.
help.admin-users.p4: Inviting creates the account and shows a one-time password to share.
help.admin-roles.title: Roles and permissions
help.admin-roles.p1: A role is a set of switches that decide what people can see and do.
help.admin-roles.p2: Turn a switch on or off and it saves immediately. Use Undo if you change your mind.
help.admin-roles.p3: Compare shows every role side by side.
help.admin-roles.p4: Super Admin always keeps every permission, so you can’t lock yourself out.
help.admin-levels.title: Levels
help.admin-levels.p1: Levels come from points received over all time.
help.admin-levels.p2: Change where each level starts. The bar above shows how many people would land in each.
help.admin-badges.title: Badge Studio
help.admin-badges.p1: Create a badge: name it, say how to earn it, pick an icon and colour.
help.admin-badges.p2: New badges appear for everyone right away.
help.admin-badges.p3: Retire a badge to hide it. People who earned it keep it on their profile.
help.admin-rewards.title: Reward approvals
help.admin-rewards.p1: Only HR and the Super Admin decide reward requests.
help.admin-rewards.p2: Approve or decline requests. Declining refunds the points automatically.
help.admin-rewards.p3: Catalogue lets you add rewards or switch them off.
help.admin-moderation.title: Moderation
help.admin-moderation.p1: Reported posts land here. Keep the post or hide it from the feed.
help.admin-moderation.p2: You can restore hidden posts any time.
help.admin-settings.title: Company settings
help.admin-settings.p1: Company values are the reasons people pick when they say thank you.
help.admin-points.title: Points Rules
help.admin-points.p1: Only the Super Admin can see this page and change these amounts.
help.admin-points.p2: Points per appreciation are given automatically to everyone thanked — people don’t pick an amount.
help.admin-points.p3: Birthday, work anniversary and welcome bonuses are paid by the app on the day, once each.
help.admin-points.p4: Changes apply to everyone as soon as you save, and are written to the Audit Log.
help.admin-audit.title: Audit log
help.admin-audit.p1: A permanent record of who changed roles, people, rewards and settings.
help.settings.title: Your settings
help.settings.p1: Update your profile, appearance and password.
help.settings.p2: “Your access” lists what your role lets you do.
